title: Garlic Butter {p} with {v}
steps: Pat the {p} dry and season with salt and pepper.
In a hot skillet, soften the {spice} in oil for 30 seconds, then add the {p} in a single layer. Cook 2 minutes, flip, and cook until {doneness}, about 2 minutes more.
Off the heat, stir in the {sauce} and a squeeze of lemon until glossy.
Serve right away with the {v} and {s}.
tip: Use a smaller spoonful of butter and plenty of lemon, and serve over the vegetable.
